purpose: Reject legacy or self-referential publication fields from the static Current lifecycle contract.

fixtures.reason: Legacy pre-publication hints must not remain Current publication truth.
A static formal commit cannot self-assert remote publication.
A release self-SHA would create a self-referential publication assertion.
Remote publication authority belongs to runtime ref observation.

claim_ceiling: Fixture outcomes are schema and contract-boundary evidence only; they do not prove publication or acceptance.
